role: Decoder for the Bluetooth SIG Heart Rate Measurement characteristic (0x2A37) used by StandardHeartRateLink (StandardHeartRateLink.swift:228), reproducing the Polar SDK's flag handling and 1/1024 s → ms rounding.

units.does: Parses one 0x2A37 notification into StrapHRSample(hr, rrsMs, rrAvailable): reads flags, 8- or 16-bit HR, skips 2-byte energy expended when flagged, decodes RR intervals when bit 4 is set. Returns nil for packets shorter than their flags require.

branches.cond: 16-bit rate flagged but fewer than 3 bytes

branches.effect: HR = little-endian u16 of bytes 1–2; else HR = byte 1
RR offset starts at 3; else at 2
requires 2 more bytes (else returns nil at line 34) and advances offset by 2; else offset unchanged

branches.cond: energy field would run past packet end

branches.effect: decodes intervals from offset; else empty list (rrAvailable false)

units.does: Walks 2-byte little-endian RR values from `start`, converting each raw 1/1024 s count to whole ms with Float rounding (raw/1024*1000 rounded); a trailing odd byte is ignored.

branches.effect: decodes one interval and advances 2; loop ends otherwise
